title: Exact countable sums compute derived coproducts
statement: Let $\mathcal A$ be an abelian category [def-sp-abelian] with exact countable direct sums: every family $(M_i)_{i\in I}$ indexed by a countable set in the chosen universe has a coproduct [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit], and taking the coproduct of any countable family of short exact sequences gives a short exact sequence. Let $Q:\mathrm{CoCh}(\mathcal A)\to D(\mathcal A)$ be localization at quasi-isomorphisms [def-weil-abstract-derived-category]. For every countable family of unbounded cochain complexes $(K_i^\bullet)_{i\in I}$, the termwise direct sum $S^\bullet$, with $S^r=\bigoplus_iK_i^r$ and differential induced by the differentials of $K_i$, is a complex, and $Q(S^\bullet)$ with coprojections $Q(\iota_i)$ is a coproduct of the $Q(K_i^\bullet)$ in $D(\mathcal A)$. The empty family is included.
